This lesson covers Writing 5.4.1 The Writing Process, part of Strand 5 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10 ENGLISH.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Learning to learn as the learner prioritizes tasks as they search online or in books for the process of writing and display the

information in class.

Values:
● Unity is promoted as the learner displays team spirit as they share previous writing experiences.

● Respect is enhanced as the learner appreciates diverse opinions as they report their experiences to the whole class.
